[KABINI, KARNATAKA – THE WILDLIFE HAVEN](https://humsafar-wedding.netlify.app/india/kabini#)

## HOST A BREATHTAKING WEDDING AMIDST NATURE’S TRANQUILITY & RIVERSIDE WILDERNESS  CHARM

Discover Kabini, Karnataka — India’s premier backwater wedding
destination, where peaceful waters, rich wildlife, and lush greenery craft a mesmerizing
romantic haven. Renowned for its serene river and safari adventures, Kabini is the top pick for
couples seeking the best destination wedding in Karnataka with natural allure.


From top-rated resorts like Evolve Back Kabini to luxury escapes at The Serai Kabini, Kabini
fuses tranquil beauty with refined sophistication. Picture a stunning riverfront ceremony, a
lavish resort reception, or a romantic vow exchange by the backwaters — every moment glows with
love and serenity.

At Humsafar Weddings, we design your ideal Kabini wedding with bespoke planning, flawless
execution, and heartfelt care — delivering the best Karnataka destination wedding experience.


Because in Kabini, your wedding isn’t just a day — it’s a serene love story kissed by rivers and
wildlife.


### WHY CHOOSE KABINI FOR YOUR DREAM WEDDING?

- Top riverfront venues: Evolve Back Kabini, The Serai Kabini

- Perfect blend of peaceful backwaters and luxury wedding vibes

- Ideal for riverfront vows, grand receptions, or intimate ceremonies

- Unique Kabini highlights: wildlife safaris, sunset cruises, and riverfront charm


![Udaipur Lake View](https://humsafar-wedding.netlify.app/images/india/Kabini/Portrait.png)

## Top Destination Wedding Venues in KABINI, KARNATAKA

### _EVOLVE BACK KABINI_

- **Rooms:** 37
- **Banquets & Lawns:** Indoor up to 80 guests; Outdoor lawns up to 200 guests

- **Distance from Airport (Mysore Airport):** 90 km (~2 hours)

- **Distance from Railway Station (Mysore Railway Station):** 80 km (~2 hours)


![The Oberoi Udaivilas](https://humsafar-wedding.netlify.app/images/india/Kabini/Evolve-Back.jpg)

![ITC_Hotels_Ekaaya](https://humsafar-wedding.netlify.app/images/india/Kabini/Serai-Kabini.jpg)

### _THE SERAI KABINI_

- **Rooms:** 24
- **Banquets & Lawns:** Indoor up to 60 guests; Outdoor lawns up to 150 guests

- **Distance from Airport:** 90 km (~2 hours)

- **Distance from Railway Station (Mysore Railway Station):** 80 km (~2 hours)
